v.t: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split
v.l: Aqtarabati As-Sa`atu Wa Anshaqqa Al-Qamaru

v.t: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”
v.l: Wa 'In Yaraw 'Ayatan Yu`riđu Wa Yaqulu Sihrun Mustamirrun

v.t: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time
v.l: Wa Kadhabu Wa Attaba`u 'Ahwa'ahum Wa Kullu 'Amrin Mustaqirrun

v.t: And there came to them news containing a deterrent
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja'ahum Mina Al-'Anba'i Ma Fihi Muzdajarun

v.t: Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail
v.l: Hikmatun Balighatun Fama Tughni An-Nudhuru

v.t: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible
v.l: Fatawalla `Anhum Yawma Yad`u Ad-Da`i 'Ila Shay'in Nukurin

v.t: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts
v.l: Khusha`aan 'Absaruhum Yakhrujuna Mina Al-'Ajdathi Ka'annahum Jaradun Muntashirun

v.t: Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”
v.l: Muhti`ina 'Ila Ad-Da`i Yaqulu Al-Kafiruna Hadha Yawmun `Asirun

v.t: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked
v.l: Kadhabat Qablahum Qawmu Nuhin Fakadhabu `Abdana Wa Qalu Majnunun Wa Azdujira

v.t: So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”
v.l: Fada`a Rabbahu 'Anni Maghlubun Fantasir

v.t: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down
v.l: Fafatahna 'Abwaba As-Sama'i Bima'in Munhamirin

v.t: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined
v.l: Wa Fajjarna Al-'Arđa `Uyunaan Faltaqa Al-Ma'u `Ala 'Amrin Qad Qudira

v.t: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails
v.l: Wa Hamalnahu `Ala Dhati 'Alwahin Wa Dusurin

v.t: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected
v.l: Tajri Bi'a`yunina Jaza'an Liman Kana Kufira

v.t: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed
v.l: Wa Laqad Taraknaha 'Ayatan Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings
v.l: Fakayfa Kana `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn
v.l: Wa Laqad Yassarna Al-Qur'ana Lildhikri Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings
v.l: Kadhabat `Adun Fakayfa Kana `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
v.l: Inna 'Arsalna `Alayhim Rihaan Sarsaraan Fi Yawmi Nahsin Mustamirrin

v.t: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees
v.l: Tanzi`u An-Nasa Ka'annahum 'A`jazu Nakhlin Munqa`irin

v.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings
v.l: Fakayfa Kana `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember
v.l: Wa Laqad Yassarna Al-Qur'ana Lildhikri Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: Thamood rejected the warnings
v.l: Kadhabat Thamudu Bin-Nudhuri

v.t: They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell
v.l: Faqalu 'Abasharaan Minna Wahidaan Nattabi`uhu 'Inna 'Idhaan Lafi Đalalin Wa Su`urin

v.t: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”
v.l: A'uulqiya Adh-Dhikru `Alayhi Min Baynina Bal Huwa Kadhabun 'Ashirun

v.t: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is
v.l: Saya`lamuna Ghadaan Mani Al-Kadhabu Al-'Ashiru

v.t: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient
v.l: Inna Mursilu An-Naqati Fitnatan Lahum Fartaqibhum Wa Astabir

v.t: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available
v.l: Wa Nabbi'hum 'Anna Al-Ma'a Qismatun Baynahum Kullu Shirbin Muhtađarun

v.t: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered
v.l: Fanadaw Sahibahum Fata`ata Fa`aqara

v.t: So how were My punishment and My warnings
v.l: Fakayfa Kana `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay
v.l: Inna 'Arsalna `Alayhim Sayhatan Wahidatan Fakanu Kahashimi Al-Muhtaziri

v.t: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand
v.l: Wa Laqad Yassarna Al-Qur'ana Lildhikri Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: The people of Lot rejected the warnings
v.l: Kadhabat Qawmu Lutin Bin-Nudhuri

v.t: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn
v.l: Inna 'Arsalna `Alayhim Hasibaan 'Illa 'Ala Lutin Najjaynahum Bisaharin

v.t: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful
v.l: Ni`matan Min `Indina Kadhalika Najzi Man Shakara

v.t: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Andharahum Batshatana Fatamaraw Bin-Nudhuri

v.t: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”
v.l: Wa Laqad Rawaduhu `An Đayfihi Fatamasna 'A`yunahum Fadhuqu `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment
v.l: Wa Laqad Sabbahahum Bukratan `Adhabun Mustaqirrun

v.t: So taste My punishment and My warnings
v.l: Fadhuqu `Adhabi Wa Nudhuri

v.t: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize
v.l: Wa Laqad Yassarna Al-Qur'ana Lildhikri Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja'a 'Ala Fir`awna An-Nudhuru

v.t: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent
v.l: Kadhabu Bi'ayatina Kulliha Fa'akhadhnahum 'Akhdha `Azizin Muqtadirin

v.t: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures
v.l: Akuffarukum Khayrun Min 'Ula'ikum 'Am Lakum Bara'atun Fi Az-Zuburi

v.t: Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”
v.l: Am Yaquluna Nahnu Jami`un Muntasirun

v.t: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs
v.l: Sayuhzamu Al-Jam`u Wa Yuwalluna Ad-Dubura

v.t: The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter
v.l: Bali As-Sa`atu Maw`iduhum Wa As-Sa`atu 'Ad/ha Wa 'Amarru

v.t: The wicked are in confusion and madness
v.l: Inna Al-Mujrimina Fi Đalalin Wa Su`urin

v.t: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”
v.l: Yawma Yushabuna Fi An-Nari `Ala Wujuhihim Dhuqu Massa Saqara

v.t: Everything We created is precisely measured
v.l: Inna Kulla Shay'in Khalaqnahu Biqadarin

v.t: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye
v.l: Wa Ma 'Amruna 'Illa Wahidatun Kalamhin Bil-Basari

v.t: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Ahlakna 'Ashya`akum Fahal Min Muddakirin

v.t: Everything they have done is in the Books
v.l: Wa Kullu Shay'in Fa`aluhu Fi Az-Zuburi

v.t: Everything, small or large, is written down
v.l: Wa Kullu Saghirin Wa Kabirin Mustatarun

v.t: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers
v.l: Inna Al-Muttaqina Fi Jannatin Wa Naharin

v.t: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King
v.l: Fi Maq`adi Sidqin `Inda Malikin Muqtadirin
